codeReview.summary: This remediation commit closes the prior unrelated app/package churn blocker by restoring those files to pre-`d79c6dd` content (for example, `apps/web/src/components/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx` no longer differs from `d79c6dd^`). However, it does not close the mission/orchestration-metadata blocker because the out-of-scope `.factory/*` files introduced in `d79c6dd` remain in the effective migrated state unchanged.

issues.description: The previous blocking scope-overreach finding about mission/orchestration metadata is still unresolved: `.factory/*` artifacts introduced by `d79c6dd` are still present in the effective state (`git diff --name-status d79c6dd^ a439ea7` still lists `.factory/init.sh`, `.factory/library/*`, `.factory/services.yaml`, and `.factory/skills/tooling-migration-worker/SKILL.md`). Commit `a439ea7` does not remove/revert those files; it only reverts other metadata/app/package churn and expands ignore patterns.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Mission/shared-state guidance is ambiguous on whether committed `.factory/*` artifacts introduced during a feature are acceptable or must be reverted when a scope-overreach fix is requested.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: Feature expectation requires removing or isolating out-of-scope mission/orchestration metadata, but remediation targeted `.mcp.json`, `.vscode/settings.json`, `bts.jsonc`, and `opencode.json` while leaving `.factory/*` unchanged from `d79c6dd` to `a439ea7`.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Shared library docs still contain stale package-location information that can mislead future tooling-migration workers.
sharedStateObservations.evidence: /Users/harsha/Developer/mailshieldai/platform/.factory/library/repo-structure.md still documents `packages/config` even though the mission already renamed it to `packages/typescript-config`.

summary: Fail: the fix successfully removes the prior unrelated app/package source churn from the effective migration state, but it does not remediate the remaining blocking mission/orchestration metadata overreach because `.factory/*` artifacts from the original failed commit remain in scope.
